# Major Donor Stewardship Plan ## I. Definition & Segmentation **Major Donor Tiers:** - **Tier 1**: $100,000+ annually - **Tier 2**: $25,000-$99,999 annually - **Tier 3**: $10,000-$24,999 annually *(Adjust thresholds based on your organization's size)* --- ## II. Core Stewardship Principles 1. **Timely acknowledgment** - Thank within 48 hours 2. **Personalization** - Never generic communication 3. **Transparency** - Clear impact reporting 4. **Engagement** - Beyond just asking for money 5. **Relationship building** - Long-term focus --- ## III. Touch Point Calendar ### Tier 1 Donors ($100K+) **Frequency**: 12-18 meaningful touches/year | Quarter | Activities | |---------|-----------| | **Q1** | • Personal call from ED/Board Chair
• Exclusive program update
• Coffee/lunch meeting | | **Q2** | • Impact report on their specific gift
• Behind-the-scenes tour
• Invitation to strategy session | | **Q3** | • Handwritten note (non-ask)
• Meet beneficiary/program staff
• Exclusive event invitation | | **Q4** | • Year-end impact summary
• Personal video message
• Renewal conversation | ### Tier 2 Donors ($25K-$99K) **Frequency**: 8-12 touches/year - Quarterly impact updates - 2-3 personal calls/meetings annually - VIP event invitations - Annual site visit opportunity - Birthday/anniversary recognition ### Tier 3 Donors ($10K-$24K) **Frequency**: 6-8 touches/year - Quarterly newsletters (personalized) - Annual personal call - Special event invitations - Impact reports (semi-annual) - Personal acknowledgment of renewals --- ## IV. Key Stewardship Activities ### A. Acknowledgment & Recognition **Immediate (within 48 hours):** - Personalized email from gift officer - Tax receipt **Within 1 week:** - Handwritten note from ED or Board member - Phone call for gifts over $25K **Within 30 days:** - Formal thank you package including: - Personal letter - Impact story - Photos/program materials - Recognition options (if applicable) ### B. Impact Reporting **Quarterly Updates:** - Progress on funded initiatives - Stories of beneficiaries - Photos and videos - Financial transparency **Annual Impact Report:** - Customized to donor's interests - Specific outcomes from their giving - Future goals and needs - Professional design ### C. Engagement Opportunities **Access & Exclusivity:** - Private briefings with leadership - Site visits and program tours - Meet grant recipients/program participants - Roundtable discussions - Advisory committee participation **Special Events:** - Intimate donor dinners (8-12 people) - "Donor of the Year" recognition events - Program milestones celebrations - Behind-the-scenes experiences ### D. Personal Touches - Birthday/anniversary cards - Congratulations on personal milestones - Relevant article sharing - Holiday greetings (non-generic) - Condolences during difficult times --- ## V. Communication Preferences **Track for Each Donor:** - Preferred contact method (email, phone, mail, in-person) - Best days/times for contact - Communication frequency preferences - Topics of interest - Preferred staff contact person **Communication Mix:** - 70% mission/impact focused - 20% relationship building - 10% solicitation --- ## VI. Donor Moves Management ### Step 1: Identification - Wealth screening - Capacity assessment - Interest alignment ### Step 2: Qualification - Initial meeting - Assess philanthropic priorities - Determine potential giving level ### Step 3: Cultivation - Multiple touchpoints - Education about programs - Relationship deepening - Site visits/introductions ### Step 4: Solicitation - Tailored proposal - Appropriate ask amount - Right asker, right time ### Step 5: Stewardship - Immediate acknowledgment - Ongoing engagement - Impact reporting - Upgrade pathway ### Step 6: Re-solicitation - Timing based on gift type - Building on relationship - Increased investment --- ## VII. Metrics & Evaluation **Track Quarterly:** - Donor retention rate by tier - Average gift increase/decrease - Number of touchpoints per donor - Meeting completion rate - Response/engagement rates - Upgrade/downgrade trends **Success Indicators:** - 80%+ retention rate for major donors - 25%+ donors increasing gift size - 90%+ satisfaction scores - Growth in pipeline value --- ## VIII. Staff Responsibilities | Role | Responsibilities | |------|-----------------| | **Executive Director** | Tier 1 donors, Board cultivation, major asks | | **Development Director** | Overall plan oversight, Tier 2 focus, systems | | **Major Gifts Officer** | Tier 2-3 management, moves management, events | | **Development Coordinator** | Data entry, gift processing, acknowledgments, logistics | | **Board Members** | Peer solicitation, thank-you calls, event hosting | --- ## IX. Annual Stewardship Budget **Allocate approximately 10-15% of major gifts revenue:** - Personalized communications: 30% - Events and experiences: 35% - Impact reports and materials: 20% - Donor recognition: 10% - Travel/meetings: 5% --- ## X. Sample 12-Month Plan (New Major Donor) **Month 1:** - Welcome call from ED - Personalized gift acknowledgment package - Add to CRM with preferences **Month 2:** - Impact story related to their gift - Invitation to upcoming event **Month 3:** - Quarterly impact newsletter - Handwritten note from Board member **Month 4:** - Personal call to check in - Share relevant news article **Month 5:** - Invitation to site visit - Mid-year impact report **Month 6:** - Coffee meeting (no ask) - Introduce to program staff **Month 7:** - Quarterly newsletter - Birthday card (if applicable) **Month 8:** - Exclusive donor event invitation - Personal video message **Month 9:** - Program update call - Impact photos/story **Month 10:** - Quarterly newsletter - Thank you call from Board Chair **Month 11:** - Year-end impact summary - Renewal conversation planning **Month 12:** - Personal meeting about renewal - Next year's engagement plan discussion --- ## XI. Red Flags & Recovery **Warning Signs:** - Declining gift amounts - Reduced engagement - Unreturned calls/emails - Negative feedback - Life changes (retirement, relocation) **Recovery Actions:** - Immediate personal outreach - Listen to concerns - Survey for feedback - Adjust communication approach - Re-engagement campaign --- ## XII. Tools & Systems **Essential Infrastructure:** - **CRM/Database** - Salesforce, Bloomerang, DonorPerfect - **Wealth screening** - iWave, DonorSearch - **Email platform** - With personalization capability - **Task management** - To track touchpoints - **Impact measurement** - Program data collection **Templates to Develop:** - Thank you letter templates (customizable) - Email series for different donor tiers - Meeting agenda templates - Impact report templates - Solicitation proposals --- ## Implementation Checklist - [ ] Segment donor database by giving level - [ ] Assign portfolio ownership - [ ] Create donor preference profiles - [ ] Develop communication calendar - [ ] Design impact report templates - [ ] Train staff on stewardship protocols - [ ] Set up CRM tracking systems - [ ] Create event calendar - [ ] Establish budget - [ ] Schedule quarterly reviews --- **Remember**: The best stewardship is authentic, consistent, and focused on building genuine relationships centered on shared values and impact.
